items.claim: Diar Nergo has better striking than Bruno Lopes.
items.quote: His striking's better. He's a southpaw. He's faster.

items.claim: Bruno Lopes gets dropped easily and has a weak chin.
items.quote: Bruno Lopes's chin is sauce, man. He gets dropped by a Jacoby jab.

items.claim: Ty Miller has a big reach advantage and is a good boxer.
items.quote: Ty Miller with a big reach advantage, he's a good boxer.
